DriveAtlas
Free beta

Where’s your CV? Your trip photos? The wedding videos?

One search finds it on any drive, and tells you where that drive is: the shelf, the drawer or the backpack.

DriveAtlas keeps one private catalog of every USB stick, SD card, hard drive, SSD and NVMe you own, your laptop and phone included, and every file on them. Search them all, even the ones sitting in a drawer. Your catalog stays on your devices, and backs up, encrypted, to your own cloud folder if you like.

What it does

Search every drive

Find any file or folder on all your scanned drives, plugged in or not. Each result says which drive has it and where you keep that drive.

Always up to date

Scan a drive once. After that, new, renamed and deleted files are picked up as they happen, and only what changed is read.

Phone and PC, together

Use the Android app on its own, or link it to your PC with one QR scan. Both keep the whole catalog and sync on your Wi-Fi.

Health warnings

Wear, temperature and bad sectors for HDDs, SSDs and NVMe drives, with a warning while there's still time to copy files off.

Know where it is

Shelf, box or drawer for every drive, brand and model on every card, and how full each one is.

Private by design

Only names, sizes and dates are recorded, never what's inside your files. No cloud and no account server; backups are encrypted.

Set it up

On your PC

  1. Download the Windows zip and unzip it.
  2. Double-click DriveAtlas.vbs. It opens in its own window.
  3. Create your account, add the drives under Connected now, and scan them once.

On your phone

  1. Download the APK and open it (allow "Install unknown apps" once).
  2. Keep your catalog on the phone, or choose Connect to DriveAtlas on my PC.
  3. On the PC: Settings › Phone and helper PCs › Link a phone. On the phone: Scan QR code.
